The Origin how a first impression becomes a self

← axonamindseemingseizureeverything

Pick a starting introduction (one to watch a self develop, or two to compare: same experiences, different selves). The seed nodes become the substrate every later experience attaches to and is interpreted through — Asch's primacy effect, schema theory, the haze primitive saying what gets reused stays strong. The first introduction isn't sticky because of nostalgia; it's sticky because it's the graph everything else grows on.

how this self has been written
seed nodesthe starting introduction — values, traits, memories. They begin with full encoding strength (haze primitive) and the highest relevance to the self (worth gate). Everything later forms edges to them.
experienceseach new event is tagged; spreading activation through tag-overlap finds which existing nodes light up (the seeds it reminds the self of). It's interpreted through them, and a new node attaches to them.
reuse → strengthactivated nodes strengthen (encoding by reuse). Early seeds get reactivated by almost everything early on, so they grow even more dominant — the primacy effect compounding.
color = lineageeach new event node is colored by the blend of the seeds it descends from, so you can see which branches of the self any later content grew out of.
